items.q: The overfill theory is seen in nephritic syndrome; its pathogenesis starts with β hemolytic streptococci releasing plasmin, which activates:
opts: The epithelial sodium channel (ENaC) with 1° RAS activation
The epithelial potassium channel with 2° RAS activation
items.exp: β hemolytic streptococci → plasmin → activates ENaC → 1° RAS activation → retention of Na+, water. (Book p758)
